name: today's admission fails an Execution while the card is busy
the card is credited when the container exits, before the stop is confirmed
replace: Exit(e) == st[e] = "running" /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![e] = "stopping"] /\ UNCHANGED holder

name: a reservation ignores the card's holder
a restarted Worker credits an uncertain reservation without stopping its container
replace: Recover(e) == st[e] = "uncertain" /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![e] = "stopping"] /\ UNCHANGED holder

name: a request no card can meet waits for one
replace:
Refuse(e) == st[e] = "pending" /\ e \in TooBig
  /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![e] = "refused"]

Refuse(e) == st[e] = "pending" /\ e \in TooBig
  /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![e] = "waiting"]
